name: Spicy Carrot Flatbread with Arugula, Apricots, Almonds & Minted Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ limes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a large bowl along with maple syrup, oil, and salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer carrots to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

While the carrots are roasting, divide flatbreads between two additional baking sheets. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl along with yogurt and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer to the reserved bowl.
Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic; add oil, maple syrup, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice apricots and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop almonds and set aside.
Once the carrots have cooled to room temperature, transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide minted yogurt between flatbreads and spread out in an even layer. Top each flatbread with carrot-arugula salad and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads between plates. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with vinegar. Enjoy!
